answers.core: Great water shaders are a pillar of a lot of games, transport huge amounts of immersion and are commonly used. Both Unity and Unreals supports that, so Godot should join them.
answers.workaround: I tried to work it around by creating a custom shader that both does transparency and SSR, but its really hard. My main problem is, that I need the normal texture of the screen, which is not easily obtainable in Godot shaders, if at all.

title: Allow Screen Space Reflections appear on Transparent Materials
